text: michael: Deploy finished for rollout v1.9.2 -> slice-3 finished 100% (commit 9f2a3d). Starting 5m warmup + verification. Please run quick checklist and reply green/red. Focus checks: health endpoints, p50/p95 latency, 5xx error rate, KV cache hit rate, coldstart traces. Rollback window open for 10m if anything major. Commands to run: ```curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/health``` Grafana quick query example: `sum(rate(http_requests_total[1m])) by (status)` I primed a small synthetic batch on /v1/embeddings to warm KV cache. @jess @ryan @tara :point_up:
thread:
jess: quick run here — health 200, latency p50 78ms, p95 170ms, 5xx ~0.03% (sampling). KV cache hit ~88% after 90s of warm requests. No obvious errors in logs. Marking green for my checks.

ryan: ran smoke script against chat endpoints (10 concurrent users, ~1rps each) — saw a short spike of 5xx (~15s) starting at ~30s after rollout, likely retry churn. Error traces show downstream timeout to embed-service. After a few retries things stabilized. Captured span ids and posted in ops trace channel.

michael: thanks. @tara can you confirm infra flaps? If embed-service timed out maybe we need to bump request timeout or scale pool.

tara: saw the same spike. LB queued a few bursts; I increased pool for embedding workers by +2 instances and bumped the circuit-breaker threshold for canary slice temporarily. No more 5xx for last 2 mins.

deploy-bot: Canary -> 100% complete at 1767701228. Post-deploy quick-checks: p50=72ms p95=162ms 5xx_rate=0.02% active_connections=412.

infra-bot: ran automated smoke endpoints: /health=200, /v1/chat sample=ok, kv_cache_hit=0.86 (expected >=0.8). Alert rules: none firing.

jess: also noticed one noisy WARN on model-loader about slow mmap on node-7, but it's isolated and doesn't affect responses. I captured logs: `model-loader: mmap slow 420ms model-quant-v2`

ryan: for rollback readiness — I pulled the rollback playbook and staged the previous image 1.9.1 in the registry. If we need to rollback say so and I'll trigger the slice swap. ETA to full rollback ~3m from approval.

michael: great. Current status: warmup complete, metrics stable, KV primed. No action required unless anyone still sees errors. We'll keep rollback window until +10m then close. If green from everyone please react with :white_check_mark:.
